# The take-over makes the slot B's; B has it provisionally again
# after the reclaim, until its press of east.
@0 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 1 "XInput Controller #1" key=030000000f0000000f00000000000000 home=030000000f0000000f00000000000000 provisional
@100 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 2 "Pad B" key=030000000b0000000b00000000000000 home=030000000b0000000b00000000000000 handoff takeover
@300 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 1 "XInput Controller #1" key=030000000f0000000f00000000000000 home=030000000b0000000b00000000000000 provisional handoff
@400 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 3 "Pad B" key=030000000b0000000b00000000000000 home=030000000b0000000b00000000000000 provisional reconnected reclaimed
@500 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 3 "Pad B" key=030000000b0000000b00000000000000 home=030000000b0000000b00000000000000 confirmed
